overall_goal: Clean up the workspace, weigh ingredients, and set up the bain-marie

goals.description: Clear the countertop of raspberry containers and leaves
goals.rationale: The person puts away the raspberries, removes a leaf, and moves containers out of the way to clear space.

goals.description: Discard used lemon halves into the food bin
goals.rationale: The person retrieves the food bin, throws away the juiced lemon halves, and returns the bin to the floor.

goals.description: Clean the hand blender attachment and soak it
goals.rationale: The person taps the hand blender attachment to remove puree, scrapes it clean, and places it in soapy water to soak.
The person repeatedly washes their hands in the sink and dries them on a towel.

goals.description: Weigh the butter and store the remainder
goals.rationale: The person retrieves butter from the fridge, weighs the required amount on the scales, and returns the rest to the fridge.
The person folds the empty butter wrapper and throws it into the bin.

goals.description: Unplug and put away the hand blender
goals.rationale: The person turns off and unplugs the hand blender, wraps its cord, and moves it to the dining table.

goals.description: Dispose of the raspberry punnet packaging
goals.rationale: The person dismantles the empty raspberry punnet, throwing the foam and film in the bin and the plastic in recycling.

goals.description: Check the temperature of the bain-marie
goals.rationale: The person lifts the mixing bowl to inspect the water in the saucepan and check if it is boiling.

goals.description: Prepare the scale and bowl to weigh sugar
goals.rationale: The person reads the recipe for the sugar amount, clears the scale, gets a dry bowl, and tares the scale.

goals.description: Set up the bain-marie on the stove
goals.rationale: The person gathers a mixing bowl and saucepan, turns on the burner, and adjusts the pan on the stove.

goals.description: Move the citrus juicer and knife to the sink
goals.rationale: The person picks up the used knife and citrus juicer, shakes out the juice, and places them by the sink for cleaning.
